notes.title: Weldiver will be part of TGAGWCAGA 2024 - The Game Awards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288340/4877bc8a37f3e4bd87d68fef9d695033d69147ce.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that Weldiver will be part of TGAGWCAGA 2024—The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards! This unique indie game showcase streams live this Friday, December 13th.

TGAGWCAGA is a brand new showcase designed to spotlight incredible indie games that truly deserve more attention - while also poking a bit of fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

Don’t miss the chance to see Weldiver featured alongside other amazing titles! Subscribe to TGAGWCAGA's YouTube channel to catch the event. 

TGAGWCAGA 2024
📅 Friday, December 13th
🕔 5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET
🎥 Check our trailer during the TGAGWCAGA showcase: https://youtu.be/prrLRWxntgg?si=e1TRaXsrpNs0rQ4C&t=6910

If you want to join our community and stay in close contact with the developers, hop onto our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/Hzd3WbFRxk]Discord[/url] server and please consider wishlisting the game to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299160

notes.title: Welcome to my world- WELDIVER !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288340/4c1330c53fa09724ed40e8bb848570a54cfc361b.png[/img]

Hello @‌everyone

6 months ago, we started our indie dev journey as a duo, and today we're thrilled to launch our Steam page and teaser trailer. WELDIVER is a first-person simulation game that plunges you into the world of an underwater welder, one of the world’s most dangerous and highly paid professions. Each mission in Weldiver is a journey into the ocean’s depths, where players undertake the challenging work of maintaining offshore rigs, repairing underwater machinery, and replacing seabed infrastructure like optical cables and power lines.

[previewyoutube=nCvGsTEjbcA;full][/previewyoutube]

The name WELDIVER combines "weld" and "diver," encapsulating the role with simplicity. Underwater welders confront numerous hazards; in fact, they are 40 times more likely to face life-threatening situations compared to the average worker. Every meter they descend increases risk, as crushing pressure, near-freezing temperatures, and toxic gases make survival even more precarious.



If you want to join our community and stay in close contact with the developers, hop onto our official [url=https://discord.gg/Hzd3WbFRxk]Discord [/url]server.
